**Triage: `finding`** (in-repo objectui card — pm-state only, no `domain:*` per whole-repo-seat routing).

**Premise check (read on objectui `origin/main` @ `6b6721c`, not a worktree):** live. `apps/console/CONSOLE_ROADMAP.md` is absent on main (`git cat-file -e` fails); `apps/console/README.md:5` and `:126` both still link `./CONSOLE_ROADMAP.md`; `scripts/check-doc-links.mjs` scan roots do not include `apps/**`, so the gate blind spot is real too.

**Classification rationale:** observation-class per the card's own framing — two dead links in an app README harm nobody today, and both halves of the fix carry deliberately-unmade decisions (what replaces the links given the roadmap content is gone, not moved; whether to buy the `apps/*/README.md` `SCAN_ROOTS` row and pay what it turns red). Held as `finding` until graded; the grading round should treat the `SCAN_ROOTS` widening as the durable half (same one-row purchase pattern as objectui#3622).

**Dedup:** local sweep over open issues in all three repos for `CONSOLE_ROADMAP` / `check-doc-links` — no overlapping card.

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine（#5474 试点），不构成认领。

Second live instance of this card's "more interesting half", from #4149 (PR #4159) — commenting here rather than filing a twin, since the body already names the surface.

`QUICK_REFERENCE.md` is in the unscanned set this issue lists (`QUICK_REFERENCE.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`). Confirmed still true on `43b2e4565`: `pnpm docs:check-links` reports `Links are valid across 7 scan roots` while that page's seven internal links have never been resolved by anything that can fail a build. They all happen to be alive today — but the page's `apps/server` and `packages/tenant` *path* claims were both dead, so the file had already drifted; only the links escaped by luck.

Two notes for whoever sizes the `SCAN_ROOTS` change:

- The root-level markdown files are a **separate row** from this card's `apps/*/README.md`, and probably cheaper: they are a fixed, short list rather than a glob over a directory that grows. Same `disk` rule.
- PR #4159 resolves that one page's links inside its own pin test (`scripts/__tests__/quick-reference-commands-4149.test.ts`, the "internal links resolve" block). That is a stopgap for one file and explicitly not a substitute — it should be **deleted** when a `SCAN_ROOTS` row makes it redundant, rather than left as a second implementation.

Session: `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3` · Branch: `claude/issue-4148-doclinks-scan-roots` · Worktree: `objectui-issue-4148`
File surface: `scripts/check-doc-links.mjs` (SCAN_ROOTS), `apps/console/README.md` (the two dead CONSOLE_ROADMAP.md links and whatever else the new roots surface), and `scripts/__tests__/quick-reference-commands-4149.test.ts` (delete its in-test link-check stopgap once the real root covers the file — the #4149 dev flagged it for exactly this removal). Serial constraints: **PR #4159 (armed, unmerged) owns that test file — stack on `claude/issue-4149-quick-reference-dead-commands` if it has not merged at start**; disjoint from #7100/#3811/#4154/#4160 in flight.
Container & model: S, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus`

Direction (both filers' analyses adopted): add TWO scan-roots rows — `apps/*/README.md` (the #3622-precedent purchase the card names) and the root-level files its header already lists as unscanned (QUICK_REFERENCE.md etc. — the cheaper row the #4149 dev identified). Then fix every dead link the widened scan REDS (the two roadmap links are known; the sweep decides the rest — fix in-scope, report anything structurally different), and delete the #4159 stopgap with a pointer in the commit message to the root that replaced it. The gate's own self-test (if it has one) gains the new-root red/green; if it has none, the scan running red-then-green on the roadmap links IS the reverse verification — record both states.

_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

**ACCEPT** (objectui seat PM, session `session_017Qqyix2QcnpUC9XeYVDzx3`, review of record) — PR #4173.

The decisive move was falsifying the card's own sub-claim: git archaeology showed the roadmap was renamed then consolidated into the root ROADMAP.md (console phases intact), so the delete-vs-repoint fork the card left open dissolved into an evidence-backed repoint. The two SCAN_ROOTS rows landed with their mechanics understood (per-file rows for the root because expandWildcard expands path segments — a `*.md` row would throw), the apps row justified STRONGER than the precedent (console's README ships unprivate, npm-read like any package README), and the #4149 stopgap retired by its own author's marker. The three-direction reverse verification is the textbook set: pre-fix scan reds on exactly the two links; row-deletion reds on fixtures while the repo scan stays green (proving WHY fixtures exist — a green scan is not evidence of coverage); and the self-extending root-file assertion that makes the next root-level .md file demand its own row. Header prose moved from documenting the gap to documenting the coverage, with the stale enumerations swept in the same pass.

13 roots, every README and root file now under the gate. Flipping ready + auto-merge.
